About Starknet

Starknet is an Ethereum layer-2 validity rollup that uses STARK proofs and the Cairo language. STRK is used for fees, staking and governance.

Where this STRK price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (STRK-USD), Binance (STRK/USDT) and Kraken (STRK/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 4.08B STRK (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
